author: HamReviews
quote:
0/10. IF YOU INSTALL ON PSN YOU CANNOT REFUND EVEN IF YOU DONT PLAY. DONT PURCAHSE IF YOURE UNDECIDED. ITS NOT WORTH LOSING 80-100 dollars. 

Game is not GTA. After 10 years and 100 dollars this is easily the most disappointing game I’ve ever played. I LOVED Red Dead Redemption 2. I loved LOU part 2. I truly enjoy slow burn dramas. This is just HORRIBLE writing. 

I don’t even dislike the game for any political reasons like a lot of negative reviews. I don’t care **** is “woke” or not. And for the record… I don’t think GTA 6 is woke. 

I do think GTA 6 is easily the most fundamentally flawed game design I’ve ever seen. It’s an exercise is how much set dressing and high fidelity graphics can distract you from the fact that all the core gameplay loops feel unrewarding and bland. 

I’ve never played a game that felt more “meh” in my whole life. It’s not horrible..: but it’s the definition of MID. 

I can’t believe I’m witnessing the death of my favorite franchise. Glad I spent an additional 600 dollars of my money on collectibles for this game . You live and learn. I will NEVER pre-order another game so long as I live.

author: HamReviews
quote: I have a difficult time seeing these user reviews. It's obviously some politics and a misunderstood leak ruined many peoples experience of this game. I will be honest, the leak made me not want to play this game for a long time and I SOOOO much regret delaying my experience of this game. Easily one of the best games I've ever played and technically it's phenomenal. It's been about 3 years and I can still play this game for hours just getting into combat and using the slow mo feature you get after beating the game. THANK YOU NAUGHT DOG DEVS for actually putting time into how the game feels and plays. Truly a classic worth many many replays!
game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: HamReviews
quote: a few more cycles of development. The story is sort of neat but not super engaging. The acting and mo-cap performances are nothing compared to games like Uncharted or Last of Us. It lacks mechanical depth to make me want to play it. I'm nearly done the game on the final mission and I still can't force myself to play it. I want to finish the game so I can say I completed it, but it's just so boring, easy, and un-godly repetitive it's painful to play after you have 10 hours in. Do not buy at full price. I would say this game would be fun at 5-10 dollars. At 60-70 USD it's a crime and I cannot believe how many paid influencers and reviewers glazed this thing.
